svg.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: GTS AI SDLC architecture. A left-hand rail marks the tiers. A developer request passes through the gts-prompt-clarifier agent to Tier 1, the gts-orchestrator router agent; Tier 2 is the p7-orchestrator (linear TDD pipeline) and t7-orchestrator (autonomous Ralph loop) agents; Tier 3 is eight pipeline-worker agents — planner, architect, developer (the only code writer), tester, reviewer, builder, pr-author, spec-author — which connect down to the SKILLS block. A narrow read-only rail holds T7/P7 Knowledge, gts-issue-analyst and gts-delivery. Each agent carries a distinct role icon. Below sit two inventories: a SKILLS grid (common, T7 and P7) and an MCP SERVERS grid — codereviewer-lens, jenkins-lens, sonarqube-lens, github, devops_jira, confluence, t7codebase, t7spec, t7dbcopy, eurex_refdata and p7spec.
svg.title: GTS AI SDLC — architecture
svg.text: routes each request to the right system
